variable.description:
(Required) The identification of the parcel in question.

The value will be interpreted as a parcel number by default.

If you want to provide a GeoAPI ID then provide the input with the 'id-' prefix (e.g. `id-23479`).  
You can do this with the parcel number too using the 'no-' prefix (e.b. `no-12345678901234`)

This documentations describes what the GeoAPI is and how to use it properly. **What is GeoAPI** The GeoAPI allows DPD customers to manage (CRUD) their shipments and shipment related data. The main purpose of the API is to provide the customer the means for: - Creating and managing new shipments - Ordering pickups for parcels - Printing parcel labels - Listing all available shipping services - Validating shipping routes It also provides methods for listing your pickup addresses and the details of individual parcels. Each user is assigned a user account under which he is able to track multiple customer DSWs (customer numbers). You as a customer can use a single GeoAPI account to send shipments under multiple DPD customer numbers. **V1 documentation** The V2 of the API does not support all the API endpoints. The rest of the endpoints can be found in the V1 documentation. For complete V1 documentation, please visit /v1/swagger. Contact Support: Name: DPD CZ Email: info@dpd.cz
